name: Z-Image Turbo 资产图提示词编译
description: 把从 CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD v2 提取出的单个人物/场景/道具及其实际分镜证据编译成 Z-Image Turbo 专属资产图执行提示词；人物 Prompt 只描述稳定身份，三视图加面部特写由 Runtime 确定性生成与合成。
when_to_use: Replica 第 3 步已从本土化分镜提取目标资产，并选择本机 Z-Image Turbo 生成真实资产图
when_not_to_use: 需要改变本土化分镜中的人物/场景/道具语义

steps.title: 分析资产分镜证据
steps.description: 只读取该资产在本土化分镜中的实体定义和实际引用镜头，提炼可观察视觉信息，过滤人物关系等不可直接绘制叙事。

steps.title: 编译 Z-Image Turbo 提示词
steps.description: 按 Z-Image Turbo 模型能力生成最终 image_prompt / negative_prompt；人物 Prompt 只编译稳定单人物视觉身份，正面/侧面/背面与面部特写由 Runtime 负责。

provider_rules: Analyze only the extracted asset and localized shots that reference it; do not turn narrative relationships or dialogue into extra visible people.
Return one prompt result for every requested target_entity_id and no others.

Character image_prompt must contain only stable single-character visual identity; image_prompt and negative_prompt must not mention Runtime-owned layout vocabulary (multi-panel, turnaround, reference/contact sheet, collage, split screen or front/side/back/face layout), even as negative wording.

For Character assets this Skill authors the stable identity prompt for one authoritative Z-Image front full-body master. Side/back are not generated by Z-Image; the canonical front is handed to qwen-image-edit-character-asset-prompting for orientation-only Qwen Image Edit derivatives. The face close-up is cropped from the front master.
Scene prompts isolate stable environment identity and must not add story characters.
Prop prompts isolate the object identity and must not add unrelated people or scenery.
Final execution prompts are concrete English for Z-Image Turbo; review_prompt_zh is Simplified Chinese for the operator.

Semantic exclusions must be explicit in image_prompt as Do not constraints as well as negative_prompt because the current Turbo runtime uses zeroed negative conditioning; character layout exclusions are the exception and are owned only by Runtime.
Do not generate Artifact ids, stable target ids, media paths, image bytes or video prompts.
completion_criteria: 每个提取资产都有模型专属 image_prompt 与 negative_prompt
人物提示词只包含稳定单人物视觉身份而不承担多面板排版
提示词没有把叙事人物关系误绘为多人资产图
Runtime 尚未执行且未伪造 reference_media
failure_policy: Provider coverage 不完整时整批失败
人物 Prompt 泄漏多面板布局指令时 fail closed
不得回退到通用字符串拼接器冒充模型专属 Skill
